facts.text: Sharjah FC began as Al Oruba Club in 1966 and became the first official UAE League champion in 1974.
In 2024‑25, Sharjah FC captured its first continental title, winning the AFC Champions League 2 after only two defeats.
Every year the Sharjah Light Festival lights up the city, a dazzling display organized by the Sharjah Commerce & Tourism Development Authority.
Sharjah attracted about 1.6 million hotel guests in 2024, an 11 % rise that highlights its growing tourism appeal.
The emirate’s Central Region blends desert sands with rocky mountains, offering a striking natural landscape for adventure seekers.
Sharjah FC plays home matches at the Sharjah Stadium, a venue that has hosted countless memorable league games.
